title: AYZEN Canonical Component
description: One entry in the platform-wide component registry (Phase 01). Every production app, feature, sub-feature, function, module, API, service, database, event, workflow, worker, scheduler job, notification channel, Telegram command, UI route, artifact, engine or control-plane is represented as one of these.

id.description: Stable, globally unique registry id. Convention: '<kind>:<original-id>' to prevent cross-source collisions.

owner.description: Owning team/domain. Required — components without an owner fail registration (Phase 01 owner-required gate).

app.description: Owning app boundary. Defaults to owner when the source has no separate app concept.

registry.description: Path (relative to repo root) of the registry this component was bootstrapped from.

originalId.description: The id/command/name as it appears in the source registry, before namespacing.

metadata.description: Optional passthrough fields preserved from the source registry for traceability (e.g. capability, group, deploymentTarget).
